Scan & Search Core

Scan Barcodes at the Speed of Light

Scan barcodes in any direction with sub-second camera detection, with or without audio feedback. Works reliably even in low light.

Scan & Search Search

Personalized Search Across 4M+ Products

Search products by name, brand, category, or label. Search results prioritize items that best match your personal dietary preferences.

Scan & Search Offline

Offline Mode & Local Database

Scan in remote areas, basements, or without mobile connectivity. The app stores barcodes and top products locally on your device.

Scan & Search Privacy

Private On-Device Scan History

Keep track of all products you have scanned or searched. Your history remains completely private on your phone without requiring an account.

Scan & Search Smart

Better Product Alternatives

When a product has a poor Nutri-Score, high additives, or ultra-processing, the app suggests healthier and greener alternatives in the same category.

Scan & Search Compare

Side-by-Side Product Comparison

Hesitating between two items? Compare them side-by-side across Nutri-Score, NOVA processing, Green-Score, price, and ingredients in one tap.

Health & Nutrition Health

Official Nutri-Score (A to E)

See the official Nutri-Score grade computed with the latest scientific algorithm, translating complex nutrition tables into a clear 5-color rating.

Health & Nutrition NOVA

NOVA Ultra-Processing Detection

Spot ultra-processed foods (NOVA 4) by identifying industrial markers such as texturizers, emulsifiers, modified starches, and glucose-fructose syrups.

Health & Nutrition Safety

Additives & Risk Assessment

Identifies food additives, colorants, and preservatives (E-numbers) in ingredients, detailing their regulatory status and scientific evaluations.

Health & Nutrition Nutrition

Nutrient Levels (Salt, Sugar, Saturated Fat)

Color-coded traffic lights show low, moderate, or high quantities of salt, sugars, total fat, and saturated fatty acids based on WHO and NHS thresholds.

Health & Nutrition Portions

Nutrition Facts for Any Custom Portion

Input your exact serving or portion size (in grams or milliliters) to compute calorie, carb, protein, and sodium intake specifically for your meal.

Health & Nutrition Explainers

Server-Driven Knowledge Panels

Modular knowledge panels unpack tricky food labels with plain explanations, scientific references, and tips on why certain nutrients affect health.

Personal Preferences Profile

Personal Compatibility Scoring

Configure your dietary profile once with 4-level importance weights. Smooth App recalculates a personalized match score for every product you scan.

Personal Preferences Diet

Vegan, Vegetarian & Palm Oil Detector

Advanced taxonomy parsers analyze complex multi-language ingredient lists to flag animal ingredients, hidden gelatin, carmine, and palm oil.

Personal Preferences Lists

Create & Share Custom Product Lists

Organize shopping lists, favorite recipes, or pantry inventories. Export and share lists effortlessly via clean links without requiring an account.

Personal Preferences Visual

Visual Equivalence & Sugar Sugar Cubes

Translates abstract gram measurements into concrete real-world equivalents, such as the exact number of sugar cubes per can or serving.

Planet & Packaging Eco

Green-Score Environmental Footprint

Displays the Green-Score (A+ to E) combining Agribalyse Life Cycle Assessment with bonuses and penalties for labels, biodiversity, and origin.

Planet & Packaging Packaging

Packaging Impact & Recycling Instructions

Breaks down individual packaging components (bottle, lid, seal), their materials (PET, PP, Glass), weights, and local bin sorting guidelines.

Planet & Packaging Origins

Origins of Ingredients & Local Sourcing

Displays where primary agricultural ingredients originate and empowers consumers to request full origin transparency from manufacturers.

Planet & Packaging Factories

Factory Traceability & Health Codes

Decodes traceability health marks (e.g. EMB, FR 56.251.001 CE) on packaging to reveal the exact manufacturing plant and geographic location.

Community & Contribution Crowd

1-Tap Photo Upload & Contribution

Missing product? Take photos of the front, ingredients, and nutrition table. Our open platform automatically extracts data and notifies you.

Community & Contribution Gaming

Hunger Games & Robotoff Mini-Quiz

Turn product validation into a rewarding game! Answer quick micro-questions from our AI engine to validate categories, brands, and labels.

Community & Contribution Impact

Contributor Stats & Badges

Track your personal impact on open food transparency. Monitor products added, packaging photos uploaded, and corrections approved.

Community & Contribution Global

Multilingual Global Translation in 70+ Languages

Traveling abroad? Open Food Facts decodes labels in Japanese, Arabic, Spanish, or German and alerts you in your native language wherever you go.

Community & Contribution Knowledge

Open Science & Wikipedia Integration

Deepen your knowledge by following direct links to Wikipedia, scientific papers, EFSA evaluations, and open food taxonomies.

Open Prices: Inflation & Price Tracker

Scan shelf price tags and cash register receipts with automatic barcode recognition to track real store prices and fight shrinkflation.

Technology & Privacy AI Vision

Nutri-Sight On-Device AI Vision
